name: HIGH-VIX armed contrarian long — confirmed-bottom via active-address cross-up
rationale: Thesis: catching a falling knife in a fear regime is costly; wait for on-chain demand to turn. Arm with VIX elevated (gt vix_floor) and a recent drawdown (ret_Nd over a short lookback lt drawdown_ceiling, a SIGNED return so a level gate is legitimate), then TIME the entry on btc_active_addresses crossing UP through its trend (cross_up only — it is a DRIFTING series, never a raw level). The cross is the confirmation that network demand is re-accelerating into the panic. Exit on momentum recovery (ret_Nd gt mom_exit) or risk/time stops. Disconfirmer 1 (does the on-chain cross add timing?): a sibling spec arms on the SAME VIX+drawdown but enters on a fixed time delay with no on-chain confirmation — if it matches the deflated Sharpe, the active-address cross adds no edge and should be dropped. Disconfirmer 2 (drift trap): active-addresses is gated ONLY by cross_up, so a secular network-growth trend cannot masquerade as signal. Disconfirmer 3 (holdout): purged+embargoed recent slice must hold.
catalyst: VIX elevated + recent drawdown, then BTC active addresses cross up
